name: com.getmcpads/google-ads
title: Google Ads
description: Google Ads MCP server: 35 read tools, 10 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Google Ads API developer token, Basic Access or above.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Manager (MCC) account ID, when the customer sits under one.

environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose 10 write tools. Default calls preview; confirm:true applies changes.
